title: Reconcile applier for skills + atomic lock commit
description: Wave-1: execute a plan (from the planner) for skills. install = materialize the assimilated/owned skill copy under .claude/skills/<scoped>/; remove = delete an orphaned copy; leave-and-report on failure (never rollback — Terraform model); a hard-resource failure aborts. Commits the updated lockfile atomically. See docs/design/addon-packs-plan.md §2/§7/§8.
acceptance_criteria: applyPlan(plan) materializes an install skill's files on disk and records/updates its lock entry (via the store).
A remove op deletes the orphaned skill directory and drops its lock entry; a still-owned resource is never deleted.

A soft-resource failure is captured in the returned report and does not abort the run; a hard-resource failure aborts with a typed error and leaves prior successful ops in place (leave-and-report, no rollback).
The lockfile is written via atomicWriteFile in a single commit at the end of the run.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Closed on a clean full-depth review (rev-119). Review depth = FULL; rubric inputs: moderate changed-line count + few surfaces (new src module + e2e spec + additive fixtures line + one-line schema tightening + its test), escalated to full because this is the only Wave-1 module doing destructive fs mutations (deletes skill dirs) and committing the lock. Verdict PASS, no HIGH/MEDIUM. Verified: still-owned delete defense (drops owner against a fresh readLock, deletes only if isOrphaned after the drop; test seeds two owners, drops one, asserts dir+entry+survivor persist) and hard-abort partial-state (writes partial progress then throws typed error, no rollback; soft path continues) are both correct and non-vacuously tested; single atomic lock commit (one renameSync via spy); sha256 integrity tightened to ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ with a real 63-char rejection test; replace-bucket surfaced as {executed:false} (reasonable defensive gap-surfacing, full replace execution deferred). Tier discipline held (test 632c8d2 precedes impl 5c7af6c). Gate GREEN: npm test 751 passed/2 skipped; pack-apply + integrations-lock e2e 9 passed. Carried to TASK-120: LOW — executeInstall cpSync merges into a pre-existing live dir; add an rmSync-before-copy clean-replace when 120 re-materializes. No knowledge draft (clean first-pass, no HIGH, no RC loop).
